cases.text: Under drought, ABC1 expression increased 2.4-fold relative to well-watered controls (n = 6 plants per group; Welch's t-test, p = 0.003; Figure 1A).

cases.text: Under drought, ABC1 expression increased 4.2-fold relative to well-watered controls (n = 6; p = 0.003).

cases.text: Survival after drought was 38% in ABC1-overexpressing lines and 62% in wild type.

cases.text: On the 10 GB benchmark dataset, FixtureSeq completed in a median of 14 min, compared with 41 min for the baseline pipeline (n = 5 runs each).
